policy: Generate all listed clips afresh. Exclude every other existing local FBX. Preview before admission.

motions.name: shake_head
motions.label: 摇头否定
motions.prompt: Stand with feet planted and arms relaxed. Gently shake the head no twice, then face forward and return to rest.

motions.name: explain
motions.label: 摊手解释
motions.prompt: Stand with feet planted. Open both hands at waist height, palms up, gently explain, then lower both arms to rest.

motions.name: point_self
motions.label: 指向自己
motions.prompt: Stand with feet planted. Bring the right hand toward the chest to indicate yourself, then lower the arm to rest.

motions.name: think
motions.label: 托腮思考
motions.prompt: Stand with feet planted. Slowly raise the right hand near the chin in a thoughtful pose, pause, then return to rest.

motions.name: shy
motions.label: 害羞回避
motions.prompt: Stand with feet planted. Tilt the head slightly down and aside shyly, draw the hands near the waist, then return to rest.

motions.name: clap
motions.label: 双手鼓掌
motions.prompt: Stand with feet planted. Raise both hands in front of the chest, clap gently three times, then lower both arms to rest.

motions.name: comfort
motions.label: 手放心口安慰
motions.prompt: Stand with feet planted. Rest the right hand lightly over the heart, lean forward slightly in reassurance, then return to rest.

motions.name: shrug
motions.label: 耸肩无奈
motions.prompt: Stand with feet planted. Gently shrug both shoulders with elbows bent and palms up, pause, then lower both arms to rest.
